renderedFields.description:
The Bug:

Horses' armor, reins, and bridles experience z-fighting.

Steps to Reproduce:

  1. Summon a horse equipped with a saddle and some armor by using the command provided below. 
    /summon minecraft:horse ~ ~ ~ {Tame:1b,ArmorItem:{id:"minecraft:diamond_horse_armor",Count:1b},SaddleItem:{id:"minecraft:saddle",Count:1b}}
  2. Mount the horse, look closely at the horse's reins and take note as to whether or not z-fighting can be seen.
  3. Look below the horse's reins at either side of their neck and take note as to whether or not z-fighting can be seen.
  4. Dismount the horse, look at its bridle and take note as to whether or not z-fighting can be seen.

Observed Behavior:

Horses' armor, reins, and bridles experience z-fighting.

Expected Behavior:

Horses' armor, reins, and bridles would not experience z-fighting.
